overview_description.description:
For influencers, famic.io is a public, online profile and media kit platform. Think of it like LinkedIn designed for influencers. 

For businesses, famic.io is a comprehensive toolkit to run an influencer marketing campaign. You can discover influencers, invite them to campaigns, and work with them.
